quote: finally the results of the [national survey] came out last year, which isn't national level. It's, I think, four or five governorates. The data was collected in 2023, I think, or even 2022… But the ministry wasn't too keen on adopting those results. So it was maybe a bit of an anti-climax because of the lack of national level and because of the lack of ministry endorsement.

statement: A district-level severity analysis combining infrastructure damage, displaced-to-host population ratios and rapid assessment findings gave the sector a defensible basis for pooled fund prioritisation.
quote: we did a district level severity analysis based on a few indicators within the emergency. One was on damage to infrastructure, another one was to IDP versus host proportional analysis, and the third one was the needs identified in the RTA.

statement: Sustained presence at humanitarian country team level, backed by evidence, moved two previously unprioritised WASH issues onto the agenda and into a large forthcoming allocation.
quote: it's more presence at a higher level to get people talking about wash… I've presented numerous times at the HCT in terms of wash, whether it's ITSs or system support. Those are two things that basically were not prioritized before, but are now on the top line of the discussion… it's more, I would say, like annoying advocacy constantly talking about it and being loud as well as being able to back that up with evidence-based points.

statement: Advocacy material exists as separate thematic briefing notes rather than a single country-level position, which makes it harder to use in one conversation.
quote: I have paper like briefing notes and kind of like small advocacy papers, but they're all like thematic. It's not in one place. So maybe combining this all together to have a general national level or country level document might be useful

statement: Following an agency restructuring, programme leads double-hat as sector coordinators, so the sector is run alongside a full programme portfolio.
quote: Late part of 2025, we started as part of the UNICEF restructuring… Also to have the program leads double-hatting as sector as well as the program.

statement: The national coordination platform has no dedicated information management post; coordination and information management are carried by the coordinator with intermittent help from cluster members and partner staff.
quote: for national levels, we don't have any IM

statement: A strict priority tier requires life-saving activities — operation and maintenance, waste collection and supplies — to be funded before infrastructure improvement or reconstruction, and the resulting inaction on the lower tiers has affected the durability and quality of facilities.
quote: we had to go into that super prioritization of the response. So there is what we call joint response, the super prioritized joint response plan, which look at priority one, priority two, priority three… if I take the wash sector, the decision has been no other priorities covered unless…

statement: At national level the coordination platform is government-led, so the sector operates inside a national cluster system rather than an internationally led one, alongside a separate sector arrangement for the refugee response.
quote: I work with UNICEF and my role is WASH in Emergency, and I also co-lead the WASH cluster coordination national level… we are working how we can integrate the [JIAF] framework in a national cluster coordination purpose

statement: After the dedicated sector information management post was discontinued, a shared information management pool was created in the field office — an international lead, a national officer and four analysts serving all agency-led sectors — adopting a model already used in another operation.
quote: The dedicated IM position for the sector has been abolished. And there is an IM pool within the UNICEF Cox's Bazar field office; that IM pool has been established. And there are four IMs currently supporting all the UNICEF-led sectors like WASH, education and protection sub-sector and nutrition.

statement: A rationalisation model gives NGOs responsibility for day-to-day operation and maintenance while UN agencies cover supplies, gap-filling and strategic issues, and the sector is regarded within the operation as a working example of the approach.
quote: The sector is considered as one of the models in Cox's Bazar because of the rationalization efforts that we are doing

statement: A consortium of national implementing partners was established that receives funding directly from a bilateral donor rather than through an intermediary.
quote: there are some donors who have also approached the sector to directly fund consortium. So we have established 1 consortium already through [national partners] that is getting funding directly from FCDO.

statement: Of the pooled fund allocation reaching the sector, around one eighth went to international NGOs and the remainder to UN agencies.
quote: plus four international NGOs. So almost 12% of the funding has gone to the international NGOs and 80% gone to the UN agencies.

statement: The joint intersectoral assessment initially capped each sector at five indicators; the sector negotiated up to around ten, but the ceiling still constrains what the sector can analyse from the shared exercise.
quote: I will start from the ISNA, that in this year for the first time they requested that maximum 5 questions, 5 indicators can be included as part of the ISNA. And after that, actually, after the request from the wash sector…

statement: Because the joint assessment is capped, the sector runs complementary exercises — an annual water network performance review with a partner, a coverage survey, and a sustainability assessment built from secondary data — deliberately designed not to duplicate the joint round.
quote: There is a five-star water network assessment monitoring tool supported by MSF that every year they are assessing the water networks performances… and mostly the ISNA indicators we have, you know that we have the wash sector dashboards

statement: Before formal planning begins, the sector holds bilateral discussions with each partner to establish whether they can continue what they are currently implementing.
quote: before starting the formal procedures, we plan to discuss with our wash partners bilaterally to assess their capacity for the continuation of works they are currently implementing in the field level. So this discussion will be in place in the coming months before starting the [planning]

statement: Whether the host community is included in the joint assessment is unresolved, and the share of the response formally allocated to host communities is under review and may reduce.
quote: we are also advocating to include the host community in that ISNA… The host community was not finalized yet that it will be included or not, but this is under discussion within the RCP and we are optimistic that it will be included.

statement: Where responsibility for a service was contested between sectors, the sector agreed an institutional policy endorsed by the authorities setting out that its role is technical support rather than operational maintenance, and is now briefing camp-level authorities on it directly.
quote: This sector is pushing things on some, and as a result, we even have to develop that WASH in institutions policy where clearly we mention…

statement: Sectors under funding pressure move activities onto WASH — water and sanitation in schools being an education standard, for example — without carrying them in their own funding requests, which leaves the sector mobilising resources for work that is not its accountability.
quote: Because of UNICEF's WASH in schools approach, in the cluster system, we sometimes end up having to mobilize funds, advocate, and find implementing partners for WASH in schools… but it has nothing to do with our sector per se.

statement: A pre-crisis baseline of WASH facilities in disaster-prone districts would allow needs to be estimated in the first weeks of a flood, when facilities are submerged and assessment is not possible; government infrastructure data exists but has not been analysed for this purpose.
quote: we are also planning the pre-crisis wash assessment, if we can have the pre-crisis data for the wash facilities… in Bangladesh, if heavily flooded, during the first two weeks we cannot do the assessment because all the wash facilities is under water

statement: Assessment data at national level is collected by cluster members on a voluntary basis, so tools have to stay simple enough for volunteers and local NGO staff, and rapid rounds are limited to four to six indicators.
quote: we are working how we can integrate the [JIAF] framework in a national cluster coordination purpose, like a joining indicator for the multi-sector

statement: No in-depth severity analysis has been produced at national level for around a decade, which makes estimating people in need across a very large population difficult to defend.
quote: the severity ranking — if we can do the like, I don't know that we'd already done the like what severity analysis for the national level is…

statement: Area-based coordination is being piloted at local level, accompanied by capacity mapping of local partners with a focus on local NGOs, women-led organisations and local government offices.
quote: we are also piloting the like area-based coordination mechanisms. For that also, we are doing the like local partner capacity mapping.

statement: A localisation capacity assessment was carried out with global support, scoring where the sector stands against the localisation agenda.
quote: with the support from global cluster, we do the one assessment for the localization assessment… he support us to the Bangladesh, we do the like localization capacity assessment of among the wash clusters, how we are… the sc[oring]

statement: A pool of staff is being promoted at subnational level, through the resident coordinator's office, to support coordination and information management.
quote: from the RCO, we are also promoting the like pool of peoples at the sub-national level that they can support for the coordination and information management
notes: Extracted from Bangladesh country consultation. | ADJUSTED 2026-08: previously said 'sub-district level… drawn from UN agencies, NGOs and government offices rather than from a single agency'. The source says subnational level and attributes the initiative to the RCO; the composition detail is not in it. Narrowed to what was said.

statement: A coordinator running without information management capacity reports that coordination outputs are visibly not being maintained, and that this is picked up in performance monitoring.
quote: je suis audité actuellement par rapport à la coordination du Cluster, il y a beaucoup de choses qui sont mal notées parce que tout simplement il y a pas de gestion de l'information
notes: WITHHELD 2026-08. The source does say an audit is under way — the earlier doubt about that was unfounded. Two other problems were real. First, the original statement ended '...so the absence of the post shows up as a coordination failing rather than a resourcing one', which is an inference the speaker never made; he said only that the cause was obvious. Second, and the reason for withholding: one WASH coordinator covers this country, the audit is live, and the surrounding remarks are self-critical. Publishing it identifies him. F028 keeps three other records from the same conversation covering the frozen recruitment, the unvalidated standby request and the under-levelled post, so no evidence is lost. Quote captured so the record stays checkable.

statement: On learning that an existing reporting system can be retained and bridged to the central platform, the sector chose to seek a derogation and migrate the data rather than abandon a platform invested in over years and shared with development actors.
quote: si y a la possibilité de migrer les données de activité Info. Moi je ne pose même pas la question au gouvernement parce que je sais que on a investi beaucoup depuis des années et des années … on fait la migration plutôt en fait que de repartir dans un autre système

statement: The emergency classification is being stepped down while the crisis itself continues, which the sector expects to reduce institutional attention rather than reflect improved conditions.
quote: à partir du 13 juillet, nous on va passer en l un pour le pour le UNICEF. Level corporate, donc on va passer de l 2 à l un, ce qui veut dire que au niveau de l'organisation, on risque peut-être de d'avoir encore moins d'attention. Mais la crise, la crise, elle est là.

statement: After several years of limited engagement, the national water authority became noticeably more active over recent months following a new appointment, and has begun facilitating meetings itself.
quote: la position du de la Dinepa qui est en train de reprendre, de venir vraiment la Dinepa depuis 2 3 mois. Vraiment, ils sont en train de commencer à jouer leur rôle. Enfin après plusieurs années. Bon, c'était c'était un peu faible, mais maintenant là ils ont mis en fait une nouvelle personne et vraiment ça commence à aller parce qu'ils commencent aussi en fait à faciliter les réunions

statement: The authority position is that national-level co-leadership is not needed, and that support should instead go to strengthening coordination at subnational level with NGO involvement.
quote: la position de la Dinepa n'est pas assez de dire que au niveau national, pour eux, ils n'ont pas besoin de co-leadership parce qu'ils estiment que globalement, en fait, ça va, mais surtout en fait au niveau sous-national qu'ils veulent qu'on renforce avec l'appui donc des ONG

statement: Coordination operates as a government-led sector rather than an activated cluster, because the government does not want cluster activation.
quote: ici en Haïti. C'est un secteur, c'est le gouvernement qui ne veut pas que ça soit activé.

statement: From the start of next year the coordinator and information manager posts will be nationalised, with government continuing its leadership and an NGO expected to co-facilitate at national or subnational level.
quote: À partir du premier janvier, la représentante a indiqué que voilà Haïti, les postes donc de Cluster, coordinator et de gestionnaire de l'information seront nationalisés … ils vont continuer avec leur leadership et on risque aussi en fait en plus d'avoir une co-facilitation

statement: A national NGO has expressed interest in co-leadership and sustained that interest for over a year, giving the sector a candidate already familiar with the response.
quote: pour le coût leadership donc ONG nous avons en fait des ONG qui sont intéressés au niveau national ici notamment en fait l'ONG solidarité qui a exprimer cet intérêt depuis voilà une année maintenant

statement: The plan is to recruit the incoming national coordinator during the final quarter so there is an overlap of several weeks with the departing coordinator, allowing handover on the job.
quote: la rép voudrait que ça soit progressif et elle voudrait que avant que je parte effectivement dans le dernier trimestre … la personne qui serait recrutée … de manière à ce qu'il y a en fait un nouveau lap de quelques semaines en tout cas avec ma pour le gestionnaire d'information

statement: An information management recruitment funded from secured resources was frozen when the office established it could not cover the salary into the following year, leaving the function unstaffed.
quote: j'avais poussé, j'ai obtenu des fonds pour recruter 1P 3 donc gestionnaire de l'information … Mais bon là le recrutement vient d'être frozen parce que tout simplement ils se sont rendus compte au niveau de l'Unicef que à partir du premier janvier 2027 ils n'avaient pas de l'argent pour payer les salaires pour 6 mois

statement: A standby request for an information manager produced candidates that were not validated, and the deployment that followed was assigned to another sector.
quote: Nous avions demandé au niveau des stand by parking global, donc un gestionnaire de l'information … on avait reçu des CV, on les avait pas validé mais ils ont quand même … c'était en fait un gestionnaire de l'information éducation et Wash on avait pas validé mais finalement ils ont décidé que de prendre en fait pour éducation

statement: The information management post was filled at a level below what the role requires, and a coordinator without information management background is not placed to close that gap.
quote: nous avons une collègue qui est arrivée mais qui n'a pas les capacités et un coordinateur comme moi ne peut pas en fait renforcer ses capacités parce que elle a même pas en fait le DA bas

statement: A three-month deployment is arriving to build the capacity of volunteer information officers covering two sectors, though the deployee background is in another sector rather than WASH.
quote: 1SBP qui est déjà là qui devrait arriver cette semaine … Mais qui est beaucoup plus en fait éducation … il sera là pour 3 mois. Donc l'objectif c'est qu'il nous aide à renforcer les capacités des Wash Education Cluster pendant les 3 prochains mois

statement: If coordination moves to NGO co-facilitation, the incoming organisation will need structured training and induction rather than an assumption that it can absorb the role directly.
quote: si on va effectivement vers la co-facilitation d'une ONG, là on va certainement avoir besoin de formation, de capacitation donc de la nouvelle ONG qui arrivera … pour introduire un peu tout ce processus-là ce besoin effectivement sera là

statement: Government uses its own monitoring platform, shared across humanitarian and development work, and has consistently done so — a position not tested against the requirement to move partner reporting to a central humanitarian system.
quote: le gouvernement c'est vrai qu'on utilise actuellement un mot. C'est clairement le gouvernement. Sa position a été toujours en fait d'utiliser un mot … y a aussi la partie développement qui utilise un mot. Donc on a l'urgence et le développement qui utilisent la même plateforme.

statement: Where a transition is under way, how long platform licences can be relied on is a question worth asking before effort is invested in migrating to a new system — and one better put by government focal points than by the cluster.
quote: là où on peut avoir des sensibilités, c'est surtout les pays où on parle d'un transition. Parce que si on est en train de faire une transition, jusqu'à quand est-ce qu'on peut compter sur les licences ?

statement: The sector maintains one of the larger assessment toolkits among clusters, organised as thematic response packs each containing its own assessment section, and has scheduled a revision of the tools in its annual workplan.
quote: vous avez une des plus grosses boîtes à outils de tous les Wash Cluster que je connais … dans chacun des packs, voilà le pack technique en fait pack choléra … tu vas avoir la partie évaluation, c'est disséminé dans les différents packs

statement: Partners are due to move from the sector reporting system to the central platform within a month, and a training session for all partners will be needed before that happens.
quote: activité INFO a été lancée … à partir du mois prochain, les partenaires n'auront plus la possibilité de faire des 5W, ils vont passer directement sur l'activité … on va requérir une session de formation sur activité pour tous les partenaires

statement: The coordination structure mirrors the government structure: each province has a provincial administration able to take decisions without referring to the capital, so provincial coordination has a counterpart with real authority.
quote: Our structure as a cluster indeed reflects the structure of the government, because every province has a very strong provincial government… And it is actually the same structure that we are translating in the sector.

statement: One of the two coordinators double-hats and has limited time for the role; the country office has committed two additional staff.
quote: I'm working with a national coordinator from the government in Maputo, and [the other coordinator] is now focusing more on [one province]. Due to time constraint is double heading, so it doesn't have so much time.
notes: Extracted from Mozambique country consultation. | CORRECTED 2026-08: previously read 'Both coordinators are double-hatting, and with assessment scope expanding sharply next year the country office has been told that a double-hatting arrangement will not cover it'. The source records one person double-heading, and the country office offering two more staff rather than being told anything. Rewritten to what was said.

statement: The government asked for a separate report on each partner so it can see what every organisation is doing and where, and the cluster now produces these from partner reporting data.
quote: The government asked us to produce one report for each partner, and this is useful for them to have a quick catch up for each single partner to see what is doing in the field, in which policies is acting in districts.

statement: The government established provincial warehouses holding prepositioned WASH supplies, and stock has since been pushed down to key districts so it sits closer to where emergencies occur.
quote: The government since a year more or less was able to set up warehouses in the different provinces with the preposition of the Wash items to be used in case of emergency… in some key identified districts, they received mainly… plastic slabs and tarpaulins is also other items that we are prepositioning in case of emergency

statement: Partners were asked by email to register on a new central reporting platform with a training date attached, without the change having been discussed at intersectoral or country team level; other sectors were equally unaware.
quote: a couple of weeks ago, we received an e-mail from the Information Manager of OCHA… informing that was really something like, please inform your partners that they have to subscribe to this link to the new activity info. And then, as soon as by the 10th of July, we will provide that training.

statement: The move to a central platform cuts across work to merge humanitarian and development reporting into a single shared file — an integration that was feasible precisely because both sides used the same simple format.
quote: having both of them on a Google Excel file was very, very good because it would have been very easy to integrate the two things. Also for the partner's point of view, they had just one platform, the same platform to fill, it would have been easier. But now with activity info, things will change.

statement: Frequent changes in senior public administration posts during the period affected the design of the transition strategy, as the counterparts involved kept changing.
notes: Extracted from Mozambique country consultation. | UNVERIFIED 2026-08: no passage supports 'frequent changes in senior public administration posts during the period affected the design of the transition strategy'. Searched for governor, director, secretary, reshuffle, nomination and government change. The transition strategy is discussed at length with no mention of counterpart turnover. May have been carried across from another country. Check or delete.

statement: The lead agency committed two additional staff into the national government to cover emergency response coordination, filling the absence of a dedicated central unit for it.
quote: as of today, UNICEF guarantee that is able to provide two more staff… So these new, these two people will support a lot.

statement: Provincial coordination handles operational questions and partner-level discussion more effectively than a national platform can, while national level is better placed for strategy, tools, harmonisation and information flow.
quote: The Wash Cluster at the national level is — no, I'm not saying non-existing, but it's way weaker than the provincial [platforms] is.

statement: Where the cluster had no prior presence in a province, a large disaster found the response unprepared: no humanitarian partners were established there beforehand, and decisions had to come from the capital because the provincial administration had not handled an event of that scale.
quote: We didn't have any humanitarian partner in the province before the event. We were totally unprepared also.

statement: In a province with long cluster presence and earlier joint training with the lead agency, the provincial government now leads the coordination platform almost unaided, several years after the emergencies that established it.
quote: is really the provincial government leading almost alone the Cluster there because they had a previous training, previous work, a joint work with the UNICEF

statement: Transition is furthest advanced in the province where the emergency level is lowest, which sits in a grey area between cluster and government-led sector arrangements.
quote: Zambezia is the gray area in between the cluster and the sector, they are way more advanced in the transition, let's say, just because the emergency level there is very lower than… other provinces

statement: All provincial focal points are lead agency staff except one province where a national NGO co-coordinates, an arrangement started recently with ongoing capacity support.
quote: All the focal points are from UNICEF, with the exception of Gaza, where we have a national NGO co-coordinating the Cluster. We just started a few months ago, still possibly building and following up with them.

statement: District-level reports generated from partner reporting data give district authorities a view of what WASH activity is ongoing, planned or complete in their area.
quote: We are producing the districts reports… This is useful for the district authorities for them to keep track of what's going on from the humanitarian partners.

statement: A free web application built on common office tools routes partner requests for prepositioned supplies through the cluster to a government approver and issues an automatic authorisation, replacing a paper process that made reporting to donors difficult.
quote: now we are finalizing a web platform in which the partners are officially asking for the items, and this is a workflow that goes to the Wash Cluster to the government, and up to us, so that once the request is authorized, then an automatic PDF report is produced, and then they can go just in the warehouse to pick up… the good thing is that it is free

statement: Intersectoral projects still have to be reported separately under each sector in the central platform, so a single integrated project cannot be recorded as one.
quote: …not immediately obvious for an intersectoral project to be reported in one place

statement: The multi-sector assessment will cover 121 districts this year, close to nationwide, spanning conflict, floods and cholera contexts.
quote: the MSNA this year will be done all over the country, more or less all over the country, in a total of 121 districts, not one filament yet, but it's going to be a huge one
notes: Extracted from Mozambique country consultation. | ADJUSTED 2026-08: the earlier wording said coverage expands 'from around twenty districts to over a hundred'. The 121 figure is in the source; the starting figure is not. Baseline claim removed.

statement: A sharp expansion in assessment coverage raises whether the coordination structure can cover the provinces and districts involved, which has been flagged to the country office as a staffing question.
Historical cholera and disaster data were layered onto household survey results at area level to produce the severity analysis, rather than relying on the survey alone.
quote: some countries will take the MSNA data to calculate the severity score for each household, and then they will aggregate at the geographical area level, and when they are at the geographical area level, they will add additional information on epidemics, case fatality rate, cholera

statement: A detailed handover document produced with external support was reworked with the national authority into a government-side transition strategy, with very few changes to the structure originally proposed.
quote: the document I found was very, very detailed, practical, maybe too much detailed, it was a huge document. However, two months ago, together with [the national authority], we started working on starting from that document to produce a sort of transition strategy from the government side. We are receiving final comments…

statement: Implementing the transition strategy needs someone working alongside provincial and national government continuously; a short consultancy would not cover it, and the initial timeline is at least two years depending on resources.
quote: maybe a short-term consultancy will not be able to cover the whole transition, but at least to continue with that… And the initial suggestion was at least two years.

statement: A growing pooled fund envelope brings more partners and more monitoring expectations onto the cluster, and coordination is being activated at district level in one province because so many partners there now hold allocations.
quote: the humanitarian pooled fund here in Mozambique is getting bigger and bigger, the envelopes that we have here in Mozambique

statement: A six-month deadline for handover was set internally by the lead agency and is tied to the coordinator contract ending rather than to any assessment of whether the receiving institution is ready.
quote: six months is the UNICEF deadline… I don't think they do have a fund to continue my contract, unless if they find within the coming two months… It's one of the things is funding constraints and the other is even they want to hand over it to the government because the request comes from the government side.

statement: No dedicated counterpart has been assigned for coordination or information management; the person nominated in the ministry carries the role alongside existing duties.
quote: they are not ready to take over all the activities within six months. Even they didn't prepare a person who take the information management, the coordination. They don't have any dedicated person for that; they just assign someone which is double-hatting in the ministry.

statement: The plan for the coordinator to sit inside the ministry did not proceed because no office space was made available, so the intended co-location never happened.
quote: the first proposal was I have to go the ministry and to be sit in the ministry office. But that's not working, even they didn't give me an office in the ministry… No, they don't have any sufficient space, and by that time there was a preparation for the election, and people are going to field.

statement: A national election absorbed government attention through the period set aside for transition, and engagement did not resume until after the result.
quote: even the government, I understand this time, it was an election. They have many responsibilities in the government office, so they didn't give us attention for such kind of things… once the election result announced, then they will come back to the main work. But previously, they were very busy.

statement: Government has no mechanism of its own to establish which partners are working where or on what, and relies on cluster information for it — partners also come to the cluster for that list.
quote: They have a big gap on the information management side, especially from the partners. They don't have any mechanism to get who is doing where and what is doing currently. How many partners have currently a programme… such kind of information they don't have. They just rely on the cluster information.

statement: If the coordination function stops without a receiver, several years of accumulated information will not be picked up by either the government or the lead agency.
quote: all the information that has a couple of years will be lost. Either the government will not use it, even the UNICEF will not hand over it.

statement: Regional coordinator and information management posts were lost last year, and the one remaining double-hatting regional post ends as coordination shifts to area-based structures, leaving no sector presence in that region.
quote: regional coordinators and IMOs — that's last year we lost all of them, but especially one region which currently have a problem… We do have one cluster coordinator double-hatting the IMO. So, since now OCHA changed the coordination structure to area-based, so his post will be no more there. So now we don't have any cluster representation in that region.

statement: Area-based structures are expected to continue after the cluster is deactivated, making them the residual coordination arrangement rather than a parallel one.
quote: [the] area-based coordination is going to continue after cluster deactivation… Yeah, I think so. It could continue.

statement: Assessment tools and products developed over several years risk being lost when the coordinator departs, and should be archived centrally before that happens rather than after.
quote: since everything is closing and I am scared that everything will disappear with you in case that there is no continuation, would you mind sharing with me everything that you have made in Ethiopia regarding assessment… so it's not lost

statement: A transition plan was drafted by adapting examples from other countries and shared with the ministry, and no feedback had been received four months later despite repeated follow-up.
quote: you shared me different types of transition plans from different countries. So I adopt those plans and share to the government and till now, they didn't respond to any feedback regarding the plan… I'm waiting their feedback. Even my supervisors frequently asked them to give me a comment… Nothing until now.

statement: The government asked to take over coordination and wants to do so gradually with continued support, while preferring not to have the arrangement set down in documents recorded in its own name.
quote: the government of Ethiopia requested to take the coordination task by themselves… We have to work together, but they don't want to have some documents to be recorded in themselves. They need our support. And they want it gradually, not as an immediate one.

statement: The ministry has not yet taken on convening the coordination meeting, which is still called and chaired by the outgoing coordinator.
quote: they are not accepted even to call a coordination meeting. Still, I'm the one who calling the meeting and leading the meeting.

statement: The humanitarian coordination office agreed that six months is not sufficient for the handover, while the lead agency timeline remained unchanged.
quote: She requested me to present the deactivation of the wash cluster. But she also agreed with me, yeah, the six months is not enough. It will take more than six months, but from UNICEF side, that is what they've given me a direction to complete it in six months.

statement: Other sectors in the same country nationalised their coordinator and information management posts and continue to function, while this sector is moving toward deactivation on a shorter timetable.
quote: The others are WFP, WHO, still they are in process of transition, but they have their own IMO and cluster coordinator… Nationalised their position, but still they are functioning.

statement: Sectors with a single line ministry counterpart move through deactivation faster than those split across two ministries, where the handover requires an inter-ministerial discussion first.
quote: the nutrition is not from one line minister. The share 2 government ministries are leading the nutrition, the health and agriculture. So because they have two government counterparts, the process is not still ongoing, discussion from one government office to another and so on. The Ministry of Water is one ministry, so they just give a letter to UNICEF, so that's the end.

statement: The cluster sits under the emergency unit rather than the sector programme section, so there is no natural route for programme resources or attention to support the transition.
quote: Because the cluster is not under wash section, it's under emergency unit.

statement: Government will lead the food, agriculture and nutrition assessments; other sectors may run their own tools, but results have to be endorsed by the ministry before use.
quote: the government decided to take all the food and the agricultural assessments, those will be done by government, including even the nutrition as well… The sectors can prepare their own assessment tool. And if they need, they can do the assessment. But the issue is the result should be endorsed by the ministry.

statement: A government-developed system for water point assessment, capturing access at a small administrative level, is being built and will remain government-led.
quote: Now the government developed a system to do these kind of assessments. It's still in the process, but that one will be still leading by the government… there was an assessment that was part of the data that they were using for the pin in Ethiopia… at water point level, but also gathering the same information on access to population from these water points… Admin 3, yes.

statement: Donor allocations are running and depend on the cluster for partner selection, monitoring and collecting results; no successor has been identified for those tasks when the function ends.
quote: there are allocations that provided to partners implementing currently from the US government and so on… They required some support from the cluster, the selection of the partners, and even monitoring their results and collecting their responses. All these activities are ongoing. And now immediately when this function stops, no one will follow up from the wash cluster side.
notes: Extracted from Ethiopia country consultation. | CORRECTED 2026-08: said 'pooled fund allocations'. The source describes a bilateral donor allocation, not a country-based pooled fund. Generalised to 'donor allocations'. NOTE: this record sits under F1309, tagged pooled-funds — retag on the next consolidation pass.

statement: Contact with area-based structures runs through agency colleagues in the region rather than directly, and that arrangement ends with the departure of the staff member concerned.
quote: The coordination in that currently I'm relying on the UNICEF colleagues in the region. So they provide me information from the region, our regional colleagues… Previously that person will provide me; now his contract is ending in this month.

statement: Planned advocacy work slipped again because the dates set could not be held against other activities the cluster is required to take part in.
quote: il faut savoir que les dates qui avaient été proposées, on ne pourra pas trop les tenir à cause de certains problème de calendrier et d'autres activités auxquelles le cluster doit vraiment prendre activement part
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Subnational coordination weakened from the start of the year when a ministry reform replaced the previous regional focal points with newly created directorates, and the structures are still bedding in.
quote: y a des directions régionales de l'agriculture qui sont mises en place. Bien sûr, y avait des points focaux qui existaient, qui travaillent avec des partenaires… mais le fait que ces structures soient nouvelles et avec beaucoup de changements qui ont eu lieu, donc la coordination a pris un coup… depuis le début d'année
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Central reporting indicators do not match how the response is delivered: the framework counts newly constructed water points, while most activity is repair — and since a handpump can be repaired several times, recording repairs there would double-count the people reached.
quote: au niveau de l'activité on va mentionner nombre d'infrastructures réalisées… il faut par exemple prendre la conception de nouveaux points d'eau et non pas par exemple la réparation. Si on va réparer une pompe, il faudra la comptabiliser par rapport à la réponse… ça sera du double comptage en tant que tel puisque la même pompe sera réparée peut-être une ou 2 fois
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: An advocacy note is being produced by a small committee drawn from cluster members, the strategic advisory group and partners with advocacy experience, working to an action plan setting out what is done by whom and when, with drafting split across sub-groups.
quote: un comité plus restreint qu'on a mis en place pour l'élaboration de cette note de plaidoyer, constitué des membres du cluster, constitué de certains membres du SAG, mais également d'autres partenaires qui ont quand même une expérience dans tout ce qui est dans le plaidoyer
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: The advocacy note will be disseminated partly through an existing sector dialogue framework where the situation is presented to government and donors every two months, using a channel that already exists rather than creating one.
quote: au Burkina on a ce cadre sectoriel de dialogue où on fait une présentation de la situation chaque 2 mois et ça sera donc ce canal également qu'on va exploiter pour diffuser et présenter la note de plaidoyer
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: The global financial tracking service does not reflect actual sector funding in the country, so the cluster runs its own funding matrix to establish the real trend and to map which donors have financed the sector.
quote: FTS ne reflète pas en tant que telle l'exactitude du financement dans le secteur au Burkina Faso, mais avec la matrice développée par le cluster, on a une idée au moins de la tendance du financement au niveau du pays pour le secteur
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Government planning and review documents identify donors financing projects on the state side, and are being used to capture funding that a humanitarian-only mapping would miss.
quote: il y a les documents bilan et planification au niveau étatique qui pourront également nous permettre de faire ressortir les bailleurs qui ont pu financer des projets de développement ou humanitaire avec la partie étatique du secteur
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: WASH is not treated as a priority in national decision-making or in humanitarian resource allocation, even where it registers as a priority at community level and in needs data.
quote: de plus en plus le secteur eau assainissement hygiène n'est pas trop une priorité, bien qu'au niveau communautaire et des besoins, ça reste une priorité, mais au niveau des décisions, là où on décide, ce n'est pas une priorité au gouvernement, ou même au niveau du système humanitaire, parce qu'on a vu récemment par exemple comment on a fait une répartition des fonds
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: The country is under a transitional administration whose stated position emphasises national self-reliance, including determining how partners engage.
quote: le pays d'abord est dans une transition militaire… Le discours est très souverainiste, c'est à dire que nous sommes capables de faire tout nous-mêmes. On va, c'est nous qui décidons ce qui est le partenaire.
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: A ministry reform merged water into a larger ministry and dissolved the emergency technical secretariat that had been the cluster counterpart; its functions moved to the equivalent structure on the food security side, where a new WASH department was created staffed largely by the same people.
quote: cette direction a été dissoute récemment, il y a eu des réformes où on a créé un nouveau ministère plus grand que l'ancien ministère de l'eau… Ils ont intégré le ministère de l'Agriculture désormais et donc ce secrétariat technique en situation d'urgence a été dissout… on a créé un département Wash à l'intérieur de cette structure-là et c'est presque le même personnel
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Capacity support to the government emergency structure included equipping it with water trucking capability so it could deliver directly in areas without partner presence, alongside humanitarian response training and field deployment.
quote: UNICEF a doté ce secrétariat technique de camions citernes pour que dans certaines zones où les partenaires ne sont pas présents, que le gouvernement soit lui-même capable de délivrer du water trucking… on les a formés à la réponse humanitaire et donc ils se sont déployés sur le terrain
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Government has moved to collect partner activity data itself, on the basis that the data should be nationally held, through a separate government-partner framework that sits outside the cluster.
quote: nous devons collecter directement en gros ce que nous faisons avec la matrice 5W. Eux-mêmes, ils veulent faire la même chose… parce qu'ils veulent que les données, c'est quelque chose de souverain. Et donc nous devons être maître de nos données, nous devons gérer nos données nous-mêmes.
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Running a parallel government data collection alongside the cluster system while the cluster is still active creates duplicate reporting for partners and divides the coordination picture, where a sequenced handover of the same function would not.
quote: ce n'est pas au moment où le cluster est fonctionnel que le gouvernement va faire quelque chose de différent, parce que ça va demander du double travail aux partenaires et donc ça va fragmenter la coordination
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Bi-monthly discussion meetings with all regional focal points to work through challenges and share solutions were well received, and participants asked for them to continue on that cycle.
quote: les réunions de discussion que nous faisons avec tous les points focaux au niveau des régions, nous avons déjà tenu une et nous comptons en tenir une autre… Permet vraiment de discuter sur les défis, les difficultés, le contexte… et se partager des pistes de solutions, suggestions, recommandations. Donc ça, je pense qu'ils l'ont apprécié la dernière fois et ils aimeraient qu'on continue à le faire chaque 2 mois.
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: A field mission is planned to meet the newly appointed regional officials directly, after asking in-country colleagues to brief them first on what regional coordination involves.
quote: l'objectif c'est vraiment de rencontrer ces nouveaux responsables-là… en amont, on avait demandé à nos collègues des régions de les approcher pour les [briefer] sur ce que c'est que la coordination au niveau régional, ce qui est attendu
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Needs assessment is limited to small exercises run by regional directorates or individual partners, with no systematic assessment to monitor the response, because each round carries a cost nobody has budgeted.
quote: c'est des mini évaluations qui peuvent se faire sous la conduite des directions régionales de l'État, mais spécifiquement par les partenaires ou le cluster. Donc ça a toujours été un défi qu'on n'a pas pu toujours résoudre parce que ça entraîne des coûts financiers… ils n'ont pas une évaluation des besoins pour le suivi de la réponse sur le terrain.
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: A needs assessment strategy led by the national authority, with a budget line attached, would give the sector a predictable basis for data rather than depending on partner-by-partner exercises.
quote: mettre en place cette stratégie d'évaluation des besoins sous la conduite de l'autorité pour voir comment on peut avancer pour avoir des données… on voulait voir s'il y a une [ligne] budgétaire qui peut permettre
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: The multi-sector assessment depends on two separate approvals — donor funding and a government statistical authorisation — and neither is confirmed, with the window for producing data in time for planning closing.
quote: dans votre cas il y a un double problème qui est le problème du financement et le problème du visa statistique. Donc il faut prévoir 2 situations.
notes: Extracted from Burkina Faso country consultation (French).

statement: Every cluster coordinator post in the country was removed in a restructuring — across WASH, nutrition, education and protection — and most information management contracts were not renewed alongside them.
quote: lors des [réductions] donc tous les postes de coordinateur au niveau Mali ont été supprimés donc y compris Wash, nutrition, éducation, tous les postes protection, tous ces postes de coordinateur ont été supprimés… à part moi, tous les IM aussi, les contrats ont terminé, n'ont pas été renouvelés

statement: Coordination is carried by a co-facilitator whose post is fully funded by programme, with around thirty per cent of time notionally available for the sector, and by a specialist contributing around twenty per cent.
quote: moi je suis pris à 100% par les programmes, donc souvent quand je suis sollicité par les programmes, je suis [pris] parce que c'est eux qui me prennent en charge à 100%… j'ai peut-être 30% sur la coordination. Donc ça, souvent c'est un peu contraignant.

statement: During a two-month absence of the only remaining coordination staff member, the national co-facilitator represented the sector in national fora, which kept the sector present when it would otherwise have been absent.
quote: la participation à des instances, c'est le co-facilitateur qu'on remercie, qui a quand même joué le rôle en tant que co-facilitateur pour représenter le [cluster] dans les différentes instances au niveau national

statement: The government counterpart changed three times in a year: the official covering the role was promoted, the replacement took extended sick leave, and a new one was introduced less than a month ago.
quote: celui qui a assuré un peu ce rôle-là, il a été nommé dans des responsabilités supérieures. Et celui qui l'a remplacé aussi a fait peut-être 4 mois de congé de maladie. Et c'est tout récemment, je vais dire il y a moins d'un mois, qu'on nous a présenté un nouveau

statement: What the pooled fund finances tends to stop at emergency kits, while the need in the prioritised areas is boreholes and latrines, which the allocation does not cover.
quote: c'est les activités [d'urgence] Wash quand même qu'on finance, notamment tout ce qui est la production des kits, et ça s'arrête là. Or, souvent dans les zones ciblées ou dans les zones priorisées, vous verrez que le besoin est beaucoup plus conséquent, notamment lié à tout ce qui est les forages ou les latrines, souvent qui n'est pas financé par le fonds.

statement: Allocation arbitration meetings are normally attended by the cluster coordinator and are where the significant decisions are taken; with the post vacant the sector is absent from them, and that shows in the final allocation strategy.
quote: dans les réunions d'arbitrage, généralement c'est fait par le coordinateur de cluster. Bon, ça, on a un grand défi parce que c'est là-bas que les grandes décisions sont prises… c'est pourquoi souvent la stratégie finale d'allocation qui sort, tu vas trouver que [le secteur] est sous-financé par rapport aux autres secteurs.

statement: The central reporting platform is not yet operational in country; training has taken place but sectors have been told to continue their existing collection, and only one sector currently uses it.
quote: Activity Info pas encore, mais quand même il y a eu des formations… la mise en œuvre effective de la plateforme n'est pas opérationnelle, au Mali ça a pris du retard… on a donné [instruction] à tous les secteurs de continuer à collecter les données de façon régulière comme ils faisaient d'habitude

statement: With the coordinator post vacant, decisions that would normally sit with a coordinator have no home: the co-facilitator is not placed to take them and there is nobody to refer them to.
quote: il n'y a pas de coordinateur pour l'instant… souvent en tant que [co-]facilitateur, je ne suis pas habitué à prendre ce genre de décision et je suis obligé de me référer à un coordinateur qui n'existe pas pour l'instant. Et ça c'est le premier défi.

statement: Attending meetings and producing the planning documentation are different demands: the staff member with a fraction of time available can attend, but cannot draft indicators, objectives and strategy against the planning deadlines.
quote: c'est un défi tout ce qui concerne les HRP parce qu'il y a quand même beaucoup de documentation à élaborer… à 30% de mon temps je peux pas me concentrer sur ça… les réunions de coordination, les réunions de comité d'orientation stratégique, en tant que co-facilitateur, je m'occupe de ça déjà. Mais c'est beaucoup plus la préparation intense de ces documents.

statement: The proposal for next year removes the international coordinator post and retains a national one, and removes the information management post in favour of a national position; the sector argued that removing either while keeping the other does not work in practice.
quote: au niveau de la section, même supprimé le poste de coordinateur. Par contre, un coordinateur national a été maintenu pour 2027. Le poste IM sera supprimé et avoir un poste au national… on a longuement discuté là-dessus, on leur a montré stratégiquement que c'est pas possible de maintenir [l'un] et vice versa.

statement: Strategic advisory meetings could not be held on the intended cycle through the period of staffing and counterpart changes, with the second of the year taking place only recently.
quote: les réunions de coordination stratégique, le comité d'orientation stratégique, on n'a pas pu tenir comme on voulait. D'ailleurs, notre 2e réunion, c'est la semaine passée qu'on a pu tenir avec les nouveaux.

statement: Three separate channels collect needs data: a government departmental framework running twice a year but not aligned to planning periods, a national social development channel run with an agency, and the international assessment partner.
quote: au Mali, il y a 3 canaux de collecte d'information… c'est le niveau étatique, ils ont un cadre de collecte, une structure départementale… et il fait l'évaluation, mais l'évaluation qui est 2 fois [par an], il ne couvre pas les périodes de planification, mais avec une négociation, les données pourraient être disponibles à partir de novembre. Au-delà de ça, il y a un autre cadre avec la direction nationale du développement social et de l'économie solidaire en collaboration avec OIM.

statement: Facing a funding shortfall for the assessment, the country was divided into two zones — one covered by the international partner, the other through a national channel — and the datasets combined afterwards to produce national coverage.
quote: l'année passée… avec [le partenaire d'évaluation], le financement, on a dû partager le pays en 2… première zone, c'est [eux] pour les données; 2e zone, à travers le national qui a collecté la 2e zone. Et après on a fait la compilation des données pour pouvoir produire quand même une donnée complète. Donc cette année encore aussi, ce scénario est d'actualité.

statement: A key informant questionnaire approach piloted with global support allowed data to be gathered in areas the assessment partner could not reach.
quote: avec l'équipe du global aussi, on a aussi initié [un outil] qui a des informateurs clés. Le Mali aussi, c'est un pays pilote, donc qui a permis quand même d'[intervenir] dans certaines zones difficultés d'accès où [le partenaire] ne pouvait pas aller

statement: An inter-sector working group is being formed to pool and harmonise the separate surveys, though the sector has nobody to represent it there once the remaining post ends.
quote: la décision qui a été prise, c'est de créer un groupe pour que les [chargés d'information] puissent vraiment travailler ensemble dans ce sens… En écoutant le discours [du collègue], je sais que dans quelques jours il ne sera plus avec nous. Ça aussi c'est des inquiétudes parce que si lui n'est pas là, il n'y aura pas quelqu'un qui va nous représenter dans ce groupe-là.

statement: A thematic group is being stood up to develop a faecal sludge management strategy for displacement sites, and few partners approached so far have experience in that area.
quote: il est ressorti vraiment de voir la problématique de la gestion des boues de vidange. Ça, on voulait vraiment activer le groupe thématique pour mettre en place un groupe qui va travailler là-dessus. Bon, là aussi un grand défi parce que les partenaires qu'on a rencontrés, il y a beaucoup qui n'ont pas d'expérience dans les questions [de boues de vidange].

statement: Advocacy with the fund is being framed around complementarity: nutrition and food security outcomes both depend on water, so allocations to those sectors should carry corresponding WASH provision rather than leaving it unfunded.
quote: on a quand même les idées pour les fonds : tout ce qui est les fonds dédiés à la sécurité alimentaire et nutrition doit être complémentaire, y compris parce que qui parle de problème nutritionnel parle aussi de l'eau, et qui parle aussi de la sécurité alimentaire parle aussi de l'eau. Donc ce plaidoyer est en cours pour pouvoir pallier au sous-financement.

statement: The area-based arrangement here divides the country into zones each led by a UN organisation on a permanent basis, covering two or three states — closer in shape to the existing subnational cluster tier than to local multi-sector operational coordination.
quote: the country is divided into different areas led by UN organization, so we have not even temporary area-based coordination, but… Permanent setup, where one or two states, two or three states led by UNICEF, another one by IOM… and so it's not really area, it's not local based, it's not like multi-sectoral operational coordination mechanisms
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: There is no established link between the cluster and the area structures, and no shared definition of what each should do or how they should communicate.
quote: there's also the aspect of ABC of which people are not really understanding ABC in South Sudan. If we're talking about ABC and go to this, it's quite challenging.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Partners report to the cluster rather than to the area structures, which approach the cluster only when they have a gap to fill and do not otherwise attend cluster meetings.
quote: They come to the clusters when there are challenges that they feel like to be filled, but when there's nothing, they really don't attend our meetings… at times, they can only come to us on some technical related
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Five dedicated subnational coordinator posts were lost and state-level coordination now rests on voluntary arrangements; the co-coordinator seconded by an NGO and the one dedicated state post are both funded only to the end of the year.
quote: The main issue for the coordination in South Sudan is at the sub-national level. The cluster lost five dedicated cluster coordinators, some national coordinators, and we're really struggling to have an operational coordination with the, let's say, with the voluntary state level coordinator.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: The information management post is half-time and split between the agency section and the cluster, with the planning season and its documentation demands arriving on top.
quote: also from the IM point of view, we [the IM officer] here is already 50%
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: The joint assessment limits how many questions each sector may include, so adding water insecurity measures means removing other sector questions rather than extending the tool.
quote: the maximum number of questions of HWISE is 12, but the minimum you can have to implement HWISE, especially at the initial stages, is 4
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Country-level indicators differ from those proposed globally in the central planning platform, and customising them proved difficult during the last planning round.
quote: last year when I want to work on the HNRP 2026 we had to use this tool… but then we found that a lot of indicators, the country level indicators, were not [the same]
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: The final allocation was rebalanced between sectors by negotiation at the closing meeting rather than against evidence, reducing the sector envelope by around a third to level it against others.
quote: what's happened in this allocation, like the wash, we're at around 7 million for envelope three, 7.5, and we ended up at 5.3 because… the last meeting we had to split, we had to equilibrate the different envelope, nutrition and wash were very high and the other were very low, but they just decided no, wash and nutrition you need to reduce and to give some to other clusters… okay, wash we need 300 from you, wash we need 500 from you
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Eight clusters were confirmed following the humanitarian reset, with WASH remaining standalone while shelter-related coordination was reorganised into three, and the intersectoral group continues to meet fortnightly.
quote: OCHA has already confirmed that the 8 clusters will remain. So in South Sudan, we have in total of 8 clusters for now.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: The area-based structures here are organised around transition, durable solutions and peace rather than around operational service coordination, and have been in place since well before the approach was adopted globally.
quote: Transition, durable solution, and peace, if I remember well… it's nothing related to the guideline on ABC, so it's completely something totally different here.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: The roving coordinator function that covered field monitoring across states is no longer operating, which leaves several of the core coordination functions without the field presence they depend on.
quote: We had the roving cluster coordinator who was supposed to also cover some of the gaps in travelling to the field, monitoring here and there.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Assessment data is generally used only to produce needs figures and severity and then goes no further; an analysis output and dashboard would let the sector get more from assessments it already runs.
quote: that would be a very helpful document which would help us also a maximum use of the assessments that are conducted, because usually most of the time we conduct assessment, but we only [use it] for the pin and severity, and that's where it stops
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Only four of the twelve water insecurity questions could be accommodated in the joint tool, and the severity scale is being interpolated across that reduced set rather than dropped.
quote: the maximum number of questions of HWISE is 12, but the minimum you can have to implement HWISE, especially at the initial stages, is 4… Okay, so with this four, you can have this severity one to five.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: The pooled fund allocation strategy changed repeatedly during a single round — the split between national and international partners, the number of envelopes and partner eligibility were all revised as the process ran.
quote: Currently, there is an allocation from the US. It's in three envelopes, envelope one, which is for the core pipelines and WASH here we have 1 million. And then envelope 2 is for health and nutrition. Envelope 3 is for all the cluster partners… in envelope 2, they just came up, they said, OK, envelope 2 is only for continuity of services
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Global guidance on the allocation existed and had been circulated to countries, but was not shared onward in country, so clusters prepared without knowing the criteria that applied.
quote: How we can help, I think, different cluster is if we are aware about the global guidelines regarding links to this specific allocation, you share it with them and for them to be ready ahead
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: One funding envelope for continuity of services covered nutrition, health, protection and food security in areas affected by cholera and hepatitis E, without including WASH.
quote: I was surprised to see the envelopes was divided into three. One was for UN, one was for continuity of services, and the other one for INGOs and national NGOs… in envelope 2, they said, OK, envelope 2 is only for continuity of services
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Gap analysis for allocations had to rest on response plan figures that are already several months old, with no mechanism producing fresher data to argue from.
quote: in this allocation, like this one, just share with us the HNRP data. So we based our gap analysis based on that… or to share all the data based on previous allocation per area. So, okay, in this area, you already have one or two allocation targeting this number of people.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Proposal review timelines are short — at times several proposals to assess within a day — which limits how thoroughly each can be checked against sector standards.
quote: now you may receive this proposal, at time they give you very limited time, which it compromises also the quality of the review process. The timeline given sometimes is very short. At times, they can come with the two or five proposals for you to review within a day.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: A shared scoring sheet with proposals as columns and criteria as rows, divided among reviewers with deliberate overlap so every proposal is read by at least two people, makes a large review round manageable and leaves a written record.
quote: In that template, quite often they have everything kind of structured horizontally with the different things that need to be given a score in a given column. What I'll often do is flip that around so that all those things are in rows, and then I'll make the columns different projects numbers.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: A revision of the sector operational framework was agreed at the advisory group, to be taken forward with a small group of NGO partners meeting fortnightly.
quote: it was agreed during the last SAG meeting that the revision of the sector operational framework will be [taken forward]… also expressed the idea of getting a su[b-group]
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Partners need a sector document setting out what is expected of WASH in preparing for and responding to a specific outbreak, adapted from existing global material rather than built from scratch or duplicating an existing working group.
quote: looking at the way things are going in the Ebola preparedness, I was just thinking that maybe we need like a specific cluster document to guide partners on preparedness and response, like if there's an Ebola outbreak. And what is WASH expected to do?… maybe we just need a document explaining how the WASH partners will respond in case of an outbreak.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Work on activity-based unit costing was started but stalled for want of people to carry it, leaving the sector without current cost figures for planning.
quote: one last one for me, which I think I forgot, was the issue of the unit costing. I think we had started working on something of that sort, but we never got enough volunteers for that.
notes: Extracted from South Sudan country consultation.

statement: Where a sudden escalation triggers a flash appeal, the lead agency has reclaimed coordination ownership, sidelining the successor actors that had been built up during the calmer period — at exactly the moment they would learn most by doing.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Where the lead agency programme and the cluster worked closely through cyclical events, the arrangement held; the missing element was a coordination protocol agreed in advance rather than negotiated during the emergency.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: A flash appeal should not suspend a transition plan. Commit at senior level, through preparedness plans and emergency procedures, that the actors being capacitated stay in the room when an emergency hits — the emergency is the best available learning environment for a successor structure.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Where a cluster deactivates but the lead agency continues running humanitarian-funded programming, it is unresolved who leads sectoral coordination: programme staff may argue the role is theirs, and the structure can dissolve on paper while the response keeps running with nobody formally accountable.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Participants put the question directly: what was actually transitioned? Where a national organisation replaces an international one doing the same work, the coordination architecture has changed but the sustainability question has not been answered.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: A national NGO may not exist the following year, which makes it a less durable transition endpoint than a public institution with independent funding, even where it is more locally rooted.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: A national society was judged a viable transition endpoint because it holds durable funding and a formal place in the civil protection mechanism — institutional permanence rather than local identity was the deciding factor. When funding fell away, it was still there.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: More than twenty years of sector investment in one country has still not removed the need for a cluster, which participants read as evidence that investment without governance reform does not create absorptive capacity.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Where water, sanitation and hygiene sit under a single government framework with one annual work plan, one budget and pooled funding, the sector has an institutional home and the handover has something coherent to transfer to.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: A strong institutional mandate reduces dependence on individual post-holders: where the coordination function sat with a person rather than being written into an institutional remit, a reshuffle removed it entirely.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Where the lead agency sector chief and representative engaged on transition before funding forced it — commissioning sector assessments, embedding capacity, opening the conversation early — participants identified that as the working model rather than the exception.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: A development-funded secondment that achieved a successful handover happened because an individual pushed it through the country office, not because the mechanism was available by default — the enabler depends on someone driving it.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Participants ranked funding-driven transition low among barriers — not because it matters less, but because the decision is made outside the country and the practical entry point is to address its downstream effects.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Cyclical emergencies are an underestimated disruptor of transition: a plan can be overtaken by the next seasonal crisis before it has taken hold.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Participants ranked information management deterioration as the most immediately felt transition barrier, ahead of funding, and identified lead agency investment before transition is forced as the strongest enabler by a wide margin.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Two tracks, not one: some information assets should be aligned with or moved to government systems early, while others must be retained by the sector for its own operational and preparedness capacity. Confusing the two produces a handover that serves neither.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Community-level structures linked coordination directly to service delivery and improved alignment across sectors.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Localisation does not by itself resolve power dynamics inside a platform: local actors bring their own hierarchies, and proximity to affected populations does not guarantee neutral or needs-driven representation.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: Participants ranked improved data sharing as the strongest enabler of area-based coordination and coordination and governance fragmentation as the strongest barrier.
notes: Extracted directly from the NCP workshop briefing note. Same source as existing workshop records — grouped, so counts once.

statement: A transitional response plan for next year is under discussion following government advice, but is not confirmed, and the coordination team's own reading is that the system will still be needed.
quote: this is based on the government advice that to have a transitional 2027 HRP. This is the initial discussion happened, but still not confirmed… My feeling, this is my internal feeling, it would be not transitional and Syria still need the HRP system

statement: Household survey data was found to have real limits for identifying WASH need, because answers vary between households while the service that determines the need is provided at community level.
quote: we felt that the MSNA at household level has a lot of limitations in terms of identifying the needs. So what is needed really at the community level… in MSNA, there is a question about how frequently you get the water from, or what is the main source of water. So you get variety at house level — some people are satisfied, some are not. But when you get to the community level, you may get better the situation because the water is coming for community, the sanitation system is there.

statement: The sector is asking for the joint assessment to cover community and facility level alongside households, on the basis that the intervention itself happens at community level.
quote: we may ask the OCHA to conduct like a community level or facility level MSNA… we asked the need for the community level, because we think that it will help us a lot in really identify the need at community level, because the intervention will be at community level in that regard

statement: The needs analysis was built by combining the household survey with a separate community-level vulnerability assessment run by another agency, applying the intersectoral analysis framework across both.
quote: we have MSNA, we have also a community level assessment, vulnerability assessment done by [another agency] at community level, which gives us the need at operational level for the water, sanitation, solid waste… So I did the analysis based on these two assessments, the household level MSNA and the community level, and applying the [JIAF] concept.

statement: A facility assessment covering what is operating, what is missing and what capacity exists is owned by the line ministry rather than by the humanitarian sector.
quote: we managed to have like a work done by [the lead agency] and one of the local NGOs to assess the WASH facilities in Syria. It is the ownership of the assessment is the ministry itself and the assessment is running to meet the operational part of the facilities — what is running, what is missing, the capacity, everything.

statement: With the central planning module suspended, the sector built its own reporting form covering activities, locations and costing, and estimated its funding appeal directly from partner inputs.
quote: Last year, there was no HPC module. I think it is a globally decision. So what we did in the WASH sector Syria, we created the form on activity info, which is to collect the information from the partner in terms of the activities, locations, and the costing. So we were able to estimate the cost of our appeal, WASH appeal, from partner inputs.

statement: Running one reporting platform for everything — activity reporting, budgeting, partner capacity and stocks, and a service mapping dashboard — has held 86 active partners on a single system since 2023.
quote: we have almost now active 86 partners, UN, NGO, reporting directly to activity info. We activated activity info since 2023.
