Activity info actually [is] the only platform used for everything for our sector, not only the 5Ws. Also we collect the information of budgeting. We did some work on the partner capacity assessment in terms of stocks, LTAs. So everything is now under the activity info. We developed also a dashboard to reflect the service mapping.

statement: Two databases are run in parallel: one controlled centrally so that organisation names and references are identical across all sectors, and one the sector controls itself for its own surveys.
quote: I have two databases. [One] is fully controlled by OCHA, which we built our 5Ws and all forms. OCHA use like a unified system, so all sectors use the same name of organizations, the references, the same references. Also I have an additional database which I use usually for surveys… I have full access.

statement: The partner reporting template is being simplified to ask less of partners while keeping the same system.
quote: we are improving the 5W template to be more user-friendly, less requirement, less, you know, for partner

statement: Beneficiary counting is the constraint on reporting reach credibly: partners running small-budget interventions report reach figures that the budget cannot support, which inflates the sector total and leads the coordination team to cap the figures it publishes.
quote: we have an issue of estimation or the beneficiary counting… many times some partner doing a very limited budget intervention in water [and] station, and they said that we are reaching 1 million people, which is not true, which will make inflation in the reach… if you are investing 10,000, that means you are not going to get 1 million reach. So this is one of the key challenges that restrict our ability to show our reach honestly.

statement: A country task force produced a beneficiary counting guideline, but the coordination team is not confident it is sufficient and has asked for this to be worked through globally rather than country by country.
quote: we have a task force led by [an international NGO] to get the beneficiary counting. We create like a guideline, but I'm feeling that still this needs to be reviewed, needs to go more deeper… I'm honestly saying I'm not confident 100% that this guideline is clear or enough… I think this part is very helpful to be done at the global.

statement: The line ministry is engaged in and supportive of sector coordination, but its limited capacity is identified as the main risk if transition proceeds.
quote: this government is very interested in the sector… they are really aware of the importance of the sector. They are supporting it, pushing on that. So they are part of the sector. Still they have limited capacity. This is one of the key challenges they may face if the transition happened, because the government still have limited capacity — they are trying to build their system.

statement: Co-chairing arrangements were introduced at subnational level and, recently, at national level — a new arrangement in this context.
quote: we have now a co-chairing at sub-national [and] at national level, which is new in Syria. We have co-chair in each sub-national area. We have also recently we have a co-chair at national level.

statement: Funding this year is comparatively strong — roughly two thirds of the appeal secured — with a further pooled fund allocation under way in which the sector is actively advocating for its share.
quote: this year we have a good funding, let's say plenty of funding. So far we have 220 million. Our appeal was 320… Now we are in the process of, I think, 70 million for all sectors. WASH will take a good portion of that because it is multi-sectoral, so we ask the partners to focus on the WASH project, to advocate for WASH in this regard.

statement: Information management capacity fell from three officers to one, who covers two sectors.
quote: Last year, actually, it was really a hard time for me because I was alone… Usually there were three IMs. I am the only one who have to manage 2 sectors as well.

statement: Preparatory steps on the joint assessment are taken in advance of government approval, so that collection can begin immediately once approval is given rather than starting from scratch.
quote: they like a lesson learned from last year, they do knowing advanced step, because they are waiting for the government approval on the MSNA. So they are trying to do everything ready. So when the government is approving, they can start immediately conducting the survey… Last year the government just had some delay in providing the final approval. However, OCHA was already doing some steps.

statement: A twelve-month transition was set with a twelve-week window to produce and validate the roadmap; that window has already passed its start date without the roadmap being validated, so the timetable is running behind before the substantive work begins.
quote: on nous a demandé 12 mois pour cette transition et donc normalement nous devons travailler sur la feuille de route jusqu'à fin août afin de pouvoir les valider et puis commencer avec la transition… il y a 12 semaines qui doivent normalement commencer le premier juin au 30 août. Mais là déjà nous sommes très en retard sur le calendrier prévu.

statement: The roadmap is drafted but not yet validated; the sequence is validation with the water ministry, then endorsement by the ministry's secretary general, then a series of workshops to finalise the documents.
quote: voilà un peu ce qui représente cette feuille de route qui est déjà conçue mais n'est pas encore validée… nous allons commencer avec cette validation de cette feuille de route y compris [avec] le ministère de l'eau et de l'hydraulique et de travailler ensemble avec eux… une fois validé, nous allons envoyer au SG du ministère de l'eau afin qu'il puisse le valider. Et puis nous allons procéder à ces multiples ateliers.

statement: The three-month period allowed will not be enough to run the workshops and finalise the documents, and an extension is expected to have to be negotiated with the responsible ministry.
quote: afin de finaliser tous ces documents dans les 3 mois demandés, mais ça serait plus prolongé. On va prolonger encore en négociation avec le ministère bien sûr de l'action humanitaire et de voir comment est-ce que nous pourrons prolonger encore cette feuille de route à travers cette transition, jusqu'à ce qu'on arrive à organiser tous ces ateliers et finaliser

statement: The person carrying the transition work covers four sectors at once, which is described as the practical limit on how fast the process can move.
quote: je suis disposé, je suis là à tout moment bien que je suis très occupé aussi parce que je fais Wash, je fais protection de l'enfance, je fais éducation, je fais la nutrition… donc c'est pas facile aussi pour moi

statement: The colleague holding the coordinator role is an emergency specialist absorbed by a cholera outbreak in one part of the country and emergencies in another, leaving little capacity for transition work — so the request is for support that does not depend on her availability.
quote: elle est d'abord spécialiste en urgence et donc avec [le rôle] de coordinateur… ce n'est pas du tout facile pour elle. Je crois qu'elle est tellement submergée au point où elle n'est pas trop disposée aussi à travailler [là-dessus]. Mais si seulement y a une personne du siège qui peut déjà m'appuyer moi ici afin qu'on puisse aller de l'avant… avec l'élaboration des documents, de l'analyse et tout ça

statement: A cholera outbreak in the west of the country is understood to be connected to the outbreak in the neighbouring country, alongside separate emergencies in the east.
quote: nous avons la situation de choléra qui est là, qui est à l'Ouest du Tchad. Il y a aussi les urgences à l'Est du Tchad… [et] la situation au Nigéria qui est probablement à l'origine des cas que vous êtes en train de voir au Tchad

statement: A cluster lead holding both funding or operational responsibility inside its own agency and the mandate to coordinate that agency's work carries a structural conflict of interest, which is separate from the workload question usually raised about double-hatting.
quote: in a worst-case (although, unfortunately, quite frequent) scenario, it can risk a conflict of interest. This is notably the case when a Cluster lead is “double hatting”, with joint responsibility both for funding and/or operations within their employer UN agency, and for coordinating the work of that agency, as the Cluster lead.
notes: Added 2026-08 via the search stream before checking the registry; the document was already S015. Retargeted.

statement: The provider-of-last-resort undertaking, which is part of the justification for agency-led cluster leadership, has too often not materialised in practice.
quote: the concept of UN agencies as Cluster leads acting as the “provider of last resort” has too often failed to materialise in practice – limiting the relevance of this justification for the status quo model
notes: Added 2026-08 via the search stream before checking the registry; the document was already S015. Retargeted.

statement: The cluster system is criticised for being organised around capital-based international agencies, which excludes local and national organisations from coordination despite agreed localisation commitments.
quote: the Cluster system has been criticised for being centred around capital-based international humanitarian agencies, excluding local and national organisations from aid coordination activities despite, the widely accepted localisation
notes: Added 2026-08 via the search stream before checking the registry; the document was already S015. Retargeted.

statement: Area-based models take two distinguishable forms: one where national structures keep the mandate for planning and only operational coordination devolves, and one where planning itself moves to a multi-sector local level. Which is in use determines what the cluster still holds.
quote: these may take a number of forms, including both i) those where national structures maintain the mandate and responsibility for aid planning, but multisectoral operational coordination is devolved to local level; and ii) those were both aid planning and coordination shifts towards a multi-sectoral approach at the local level, rather than a sector-specific lens at the national level

statement: Area-based models reposition clusters as technical reference points at national level — quality assurance, standards development and roll-out, and sharing practice across contexts — rather than as the holders of operational coordination.
quote: ABC models therefore entail a repositioning of Clusters as technical reference points at the national level – responsible for quality assurance, the development and roll-out of standards through tools and approaches, and the sharing of best practices, both within and across contexts
notes: Added 2026-08 via the search stream before checking the registry; the document was already S015. Retargeted.

statement: Area-based pilots have so far struggled to arrive at an operational model that works and satisfies the priorities of all the actors involved.
quote: ABC pilots to date have proved challenging in coming up with an operational model that works well and suits the priorities of all stakeholders
notes: Added 2026-08 via the search stream before checking the registry; the document was already S015. Retargeted.

statement: Overall response planning and coordination is expected to remain a national-level agreement even under area-based models, to hold coherence and buy-in — so the question is which functions move, not whether the national tier survives.
quote: Overall response planning and coordination will likely always need to be agreed at the central/ national level, to ensure coherence and buy-in, and will therefore continue to involve the Humanitarian Country Team (HCT) and Cluster architecture at the macro level

statement: A national partner in an accelerated transition named the central risk as symbolic localisation: responsibilities moving to national actors without the authority, resources or decision-making power that would make them real.
quote: [the national partner] also warns about the risk of "symbolic localization, without power transition." A situation where responsibilities move to national actors without the corresponding transfer of authority, resources or decision-making power… Localization cannot stop at participation.
notes: Speaker named in the published source and speaking publicly at HNPW; redacted here anyway so the base has one convention rather than two. Attribution is in sources.csv via the URL.

statement: Funding gaps after deactivation are the principal concern of the national organisations expected to carry operations afterwards.
quote: Funding gaps after the Cluster deactivates are a big worry, especially for national organizations expected to keep operations going.

statement: Where information management is being migrated into a national system as part of the transition, the migration has to keep pace with the deactivation or a coordination gap opens between the two.
quote: The information management transition to DHIS2, described above, must keep pace to avoid coordination gaps. In insecure areas, services could be interrupted if coordination structures weaken before national systems are ready.

statement: National partners set out what a workable transition needs from their side: multi-year and flexible funding, continued investment in institutional capacity, access to pooled funding and direct donor engagement, and technical mentorship running through the transition period.
quote: several conditions are key for a successful transition: multi-year and flexible funding, continued investment in institutional capacity, access to pooled funding and direct donor engagement, and ongoing technical mentorship during the transition period

statement: The lead agency retains the provider-of-last-resort role after the cluster deactivates, with some technical functions such as standards and guidance held temporarily during the transition rather than transferred at the point of closure.
quote: National organizations are increasingly positioned to assume greater leadership roles in support of the Ministry of Public Health, while WHO will remain the Provider of Last Resort… Some technical functions, such as standards and guidance, remain temporarily in place during the transition.

statement: Different coordination models are being applied in different regions of the same country according to the nature of the crisis — area-based coordination in two regions and a variant of it in a third — rather than one model applied nationally.
quote: The transition promotes context-adapted coordination models, including Area-Based Coordination (ABC) in the North-West and South-West and ABC+ in the Far North.

statement: Leadership of the successor coordination structure is being selected by a vote among participating organisations rather than by appointment.
quote: Leadership selection within the new coordination structure is inclusive, letting organizations vote in the selection process.

statement: The transition runs in phases across three years, opening with formal communication to the line ministry and an identification of capacity-building needs, then strengthening sector coordination jointly with the ministry, then migrating information management into national systems, ending with humanitarian preparedness written into national sector planning.
quote: the transition will happen in phases from 2025 to 2027. The first phase started with official communication with the Ministry of Public Health and identified capacity-building needs. Later phases will strengthen sector coordination, led by WHO and the Ministry, and bring information management tools like DHIS2 into national systems. By the end, humanitarian preparedness and response should be part of national health planning.

statement: This country is one of eight piloting an accelerated transition to nationally anchored coordination under the humanitarian reset, with a proposed deactivation date at the end of the year.
quote: Cameroon has been selected as one of eight countries piloting an accelerated transition toward nationally anchored humanitarian coordination… The deactivation of the Health Cluster in Cameroon is proposed for the end of 2026.

statement: The provider-of-last-resort commitment was found not to be practically relevant to how lead agencies work, with large gaps continuing to go unfilled — a finding first recorded in 2007 and still being made.
quote: there is acknowledgement that large gaps continue to go unfilled, and as a result most fail to see the practical relevance of the concept of Provider of Last Resort (POLR) to their work

statement: Stronger and more predictable sectoral leadership did not produce a matching increase in accountability. A poorly performing lead agency relinquishing its role at the humanitarian coordinator's request had not been demonstrated in any setting examined.
quote: The approach has helped to foster stronger and more predictable leadership over sectors. However, there has been no observable increase in ultimate accountability… Accountability of agencies to the HC (in the form of poor performers relinquishing their lead responsibilities at the HC's behest) has not yet been positively demonstrated in any field setting examined.

statement: Local and national organisations saw no significant increase in participation, funding or partnership opportunities through the cluster approach — recorded in 2007 and still the position reported today.
quote: local NGOs did not see significant levels of increased participation or enhanced opportunities for funding and partnerships via the cluster approach

statement: International NGOs were already receiving a greater share of their funding through cluster lead agencies, which apply slow and burdensome grant-making procedures.
quote: there is evidence that INGOs are already receiving greater proportions of their funding through cluster lead agencies, which continue to follow slow and burdensome grant-making procedures

statement: Coordination introduced in a way that duplicates rather than replaces or strengthens what already exists is labour-intensive and adds burden on staff and partners.
quote: The cluster approach can be labour-intensive and can impose additional burdens on staff and stakeholders, especially when introduced in a way that duplicates rather than supplants or strengthens existing coordination mechanisms.

statement: Activating a large number of coordination structures without considering whether each was needed weakened the ability to prioritise interventions and allocate resources.
quote: Prioritisation of response often faltered in the sudden-onset cases, when a large number of clusters (e.g. 11) were activated without due consideration of the need for each of them. This weakened the overall ability to prioritise interventions and allocate resources.

statement: Joint needs assessments increased in number but their quality and usefulness remained short of what was needed, with the harmonisation of tools unresolved — a position recorded in 2007 and still described by country teams.
quote: Joint needs assessments have increased in number, but their quality and usefulness remain less than optimal, while debates continue on how to harmonise tools. Monitoring and evaluation continue to represent a glaring deficiency in humanitarian response, and were not seen to improve under clusters.

statement: Engagement with host states was mixed and lacked strategic guidance, with no clear differentiation between natural disaster and conflict settings, or between contexts with strong national authorities and those without.
quote: Engagement of host states has been mixed, and overall has suffered from insufficient emphasis and strategic focus. The interface with national authorities overall lacks strong strategic guidance. It should be considered more thoughtfully and a clear differentiation made between approaches to natural disasters and conflict-related emergencies, and cases where there are strong national authorities and disaster management structures.

statement: Where a cluster performed poorly or failed to add value, it was generally attributed to weak leadership — low operational capacity in the lead agency, or weak coordination skills in the people placed in coordinating roles.
quote: Where a cluster performed poorly or failed to add value this was generally attributed to weak leadership – a low level of operational capacity of the lead agency and/or weak coordination skills among personnel placed in coordinating roles.

statement: In protracted emergencies, sector coordination proved better able to gather information on response capacity and gaps and to redirect partners to fill them, and drove capacity increases and the extension of coordination to deeper field levels.
quote: In chronic emergencies in particular, the clusterised sectors have shown themselves better able to gather the necessary information on response capacities and gaps in services, and cluster lead agencies have been successful in directing or redirecting partners to fill those gaps. The responsibilities of cluster leadership have also helped to drive capacity increases within these agencies, and the extension of coordination to deeper field levels.

statement: A sudden-onset emergency inside a protracted crisis draws in organisations with no prior presence, most of which approach the cluster without understanding what a cluster is or how coordination is arranged in the country.
quote: muchos ni siquiera entendían bien lo que era un cluster o cómo funcionaban las estructuras de coordinación

statement: Screening an influx of new organisations falls to the coordination team as unplanned bilateral work, on top of the existing coordination load and with no additional capacity.
quote: nos ha llevado un poco a tomar espacios bilaterales para entender un poco cuál sería su mandato

statement: Organisations arriving for a short rapid-response window cannot say what they will be doing afterwards, so the cluster cannot tell whether admitting them to the sector is a lasting arrangement or a temporary one.
quote: algunos venían en el marco de un rapid response de una semana un mes 2 meses máximo y no tenían mucha visibilidad de lo que sería su implementación a posteriori

statement: Some newly arriving organisations did not meet minimum safeguarding and protection-from-exploitation requirements, which the coordination team had to establish case by case before admitting them.
quote: Algunos tampoco tenían elementos relativos a o mínimos relativos a pea salvaguarda

statement: Incoming organisations implement without engaging the coordination structure, and in doing so put at risk relationships with national authorities that the humanitarian community built over several years.
quote: cuidar la estructura que hemos venido trabajando con las autoridades desde el 2019 las relaciones con las autoridades siempre son muy delicadas

statement: A sudden-onset disaster made national authorities more willing to meet coordination structures than they had been for years, opening an engagement window that predates none of the new arrivals.
quote: Ahorita del terremoto para acá es que han estado un poco más accesible a tener reuniones a sentarse con la parte de por ejemplo con clúster

statement: Staff hired specifically for an emergency surge, on one- and two-month contracts, bypass established coordination because delivering within their contract leaves no time to work at the pace of the existing structure.
quote: vienen contratados por un mes 2 meses y bueno vienen básicamente atropellando la arquitectura humanitaria porque necesitan dar respuesta

statement: Local and long-established national organisations report feeling displaced by incoming international actors, not only for funding but for access to affected areas and to partnership opportunities.
quote: se sienten desplazados o con el riesgo de ser desplazados para oportunidades no solo de financiamiento sino de acceso

statement: The cluster passed lists of established local partners to the humanitarian coordination office so that funding opportunities could reach them, using its partner knowledge as a localisation instrument.
quote: brindando a OCHA un poco algunas listas de socios locales para que con oportunidades de financiamiento pues los puedan tener en cuenta

statement: Membership renewal was kept open all year rather than run as an annual cycle, so organisations that had withdrawn during the previous year's funding contraction could rejoin by expressing interest against the sector's stated minimum criteria.
quote: tuvimos también una flexibilización de la dinámica que teníamos para la renovación de membresías

statement: A funding contraction the previous year pushed WASH actors out of the country, so the response to a new emergency began with fewer known partners than the country had before.
quote: actores que por el desfinanciamiento del año pasado o por otras circunstancias se habían replegado un poco habían salido del país

statement: Coordinators were contacted through every available channel at once during the surge, and managing that contact became a significant drain on the coordination team.
quote: esto nos ha supuesto primero un desgaste absoluto de los temas de comunicación porque nos han contactado por todas las vías posibles

statement: Operational and technical tables were set up inside individual displacement sites so that organisations working in the same site would not duplicate each other, rather than coordinating them only through the national sector meeting.
quote: en 5 campamentos se han estado desarrollando algunas mesas operativas slash técnicas para no duplicar esfuerzos en los mismos campamentos

statement: Access to some displacement sites is guaranteed through particular UN agencies' relationships with the authorities, and other organisations reach those sites through that channel — so who can coordinate where is set by agency-level relationships rather than by the sector.
quote: estos campamentos se han denominado como liderados por ONU porque tienen un poco el acceso garantizado a través de la relación gubernamental

statement: Sector coordination had no standing presence in the worst-affected area, so the coordination team could only visit for specific information-gathering and could not see how site-level dynamics were working.
quote: es muy importante que haya presencia y sentarnos con las organizaciones que ya están haciendo vida sí creo que es una brecha

statement: A local coordination forum covering several states gave the sector a route to raise technical issues directly with a state government, which produced joint training for site managers on waste management and vector control.
quote: a través de el foro local de coordinación de distrito capital Miranda y ahora La Guaira tener espacios con la gobernación

statement: A local coordination forum is being established in the worst-affected area, and the sector is proposing that it carry a mapping instrument capable of showing sector-specific activity at that level.
quote: estamos viendo también una forma de plantearle al foro local de coordinación que se va a instalar en La Guaira una herramienta más concreta probablemente a nivel intersectorial

statement: Solid waste management sits between sectors: inside displacement sites it falls between shelter and WASH, and in communities it merges with debris removal, which is a municipal and state responsibility rather than a humanitarian one.
quote: a nivel comunitario se mezcla con todos los temas de remoción de escombros y otros temas que son un poco menos controlables

statement: Services that fall between sector mandates in displacement sites — laundry, washing and drying space, cooking and eating areas — are routinely left out of planning because no sector owns them.
quote: por el hecho de ser tantos sectores de vez en cuando perdemos algunos elementos y muchas veces lo que perdemos en términos wash son elementos de lavandería

statement: A health-sector actor ran a parallel WASH implementation and circulated its own WASH information tools without validating them with the sector, so two sets of sector data existed at once.
quote: han compartido herramientas de integración de información de Wash para la respuesta las cuales no han validado con la coordinación

statement: Where WASH and health responsibilities meet, the division of labour has never been formalised in the country, and each response reopens the same question of who covers what.
quote: nunca lo hemos formalizado siempre hemos tomado ese matriz como base para acordar una cosa u otra

statement: A cross-cluster responsibility matrix, setting out what each sector needs from the other and what the two must do jointly, gives two sectors a documented basis for agreeing a division of labour instead of renegotiating it verbally each time.
quote: hay lo que el cluster Wash quiere del otro cluster lo que el otro cluster quiere del cluster Wash y hay actividades que los 2 cluster tienen que cooperar juntos

statement: During an earlier emergency the two sectors worked under a joint leadership arrangement in which one sector carried most of the work while the other retained visible co-leadership, which was enough to keep the two aligned.
quote: fue un liderazgo conjunto de una manera en lo cual nosotros hacíamos la mayoría del trabajo pero daba la posibilidad a ello de decir estamos liderando

statement: UN agencies run parts of the response and engage authorities directly, somewhat apart from the coordination structures, which makes it difficult for the inter-sector group to align all of the response.
quote: a veces se hace muy difícil coordinar necesariamente todas las acciones de las agencias de Naciones Unidas sobre todo aquellas que tienen interlocución directa con actores de gobierno

statement: Clusters were not brought into the post-disaster needs assessment at the outset, learning about it indirectly through agency programme sections while the assessment was being shaped with government, development banks and international financial institutions.
quote: los clusters no habíamos sido del todo involucrados en primera línea para el PDNA

statement: Recovery planning after a disaster is convened between government and development finance actors, and sector coordination structures have no defined route into it even though the reconstruction being planned is in their sector.
quote: mirar un poco también la oportunidad en la que los clusters podamos entrar y entender un poco en dónde están

statement: The needs assessment for the coming planning cycle moved from key-informant interviews to household-level data collection, giving broader coverage than previous years.
quote: es un levantamiento en hogares y no los de años pasados habían sido a nivel de informantes clave

statement: Rapid needs assessments run for two separate sudden-onset events were built on a common instrument, so both can be folded into the same analysis for the planning cycle.
quote: esos insumos también estarán bajo el mismo instrumento que se usó para el rapid needs assessment

statement: A sudden-onset emergency displaced the planning calendar for the following year, pushing back the main data collection and leaving the analysis timetable unsettled.
quote: con todo el tema terremoto pues obviamente las fechas del levantamiento se van a rodar un poco

statement: The sector set aside part of its capacity-building budget to run a workshop with partners on harmonising information ahead of the planning cycle, rather than treating analysis as a coordination-team task.
quote: revisando algunos presupuestos y fondos que tenemos para fortalecimientos de capacidades de clúster de reservar un poco para tener un taller

statement: A partner capacity-mapping instrument built for displacement sites and communities is being extended to institutions after partners asked for health facilities to be mapped, with schools expected to follow.
quote: ya tenemos bastante avanzado un instrumento de mapeo de capacidades y hoy mismo nos planteábamos la necesidad de hacer una adaptación rápida para expandirlo a instituciones

statement: A capacity map built in the first week after a disaster went out of date quickly, because it recorded who was present but not the funding and activity changes that followed.
quote: lanzamos un mapa de capacidades muy sencillo pero se nos quedó corto con las actualizaciones en temas de financiamiento en temas de actividades

statement: The sector convened a meeting for the specific group of partners working in health facilities, rather than raising the issue in the general sector meeting, in order to prevent duplication in that setting.
quote: se coordinó un espacio específico para aquellos socios que quieran implementar en establecimientos de salud específicamente

statement: Sector meetings were opened to every actor present rather than to members only, which reached the new arrivals but made the meetings harder to run and drew in suppliers and private-sector actors offering services.
quote: abierta a todos los actores en terreno esto nos suponía algunos retos de un poco de control del espacio

statement: Pooled fund allocation required the inter-sector group to agree a joint strategy first, which gave the sector a defined place in the allocation process rather than a reactive one.
quote: nos han pedido la definición a través del grupo intercluster de una estrategia intersectorial

statement: The sector reviewed every funding proposal and project extension for technical coherence and indicator alignment before submission, using field visits already made with the fund's own team as a check.
quote: hemos podido revisar la mayoría de estas propuestas mirar que tengan coherencia tanto para nuevas asignaciones como para aquellos proyectos que están presentando extensiones

statement: Donors attended regular sector meetings and held bilateral sessions with the coordination team on gaps and the six- to twelve-month outlook, which gave the sector a direct channel into allocation decisions.
quote: hemos tenido espacios de participación de algunos donantes en nuestras reuniones de cluster

statement: The same pattern of unaffiliated organisations arriving after a sudden-onset disaster, willing to work but unfamiliar with cluster structures, was reported from a separate response in the same region.
quote: fue muy similar a la que ocurrió en Jamaica con los recientes ciclones avalancha de organizaciones muchas de ellas con mucha voluntad de realizar actividades pero sin conocimiento de estructura de cluster

statement: The transition roadmap has to be validated by the water ministry's Secretary General before workshops can begin, so a single signature sits between a drafted plan and any implementation.
quote: nous allons envoyer au SG du ministère de l'eau afin qu'il puisse le valider et puis nous allons procéder à ces multiples ateliers

statement: Transition planning stalled for want of someone to do it: the roadmap, the analysis and the supporting documents were all waiting on a request for a dedicated person from headquarters, because nobody in country had the time.
quote: si seulement y a une personne du siège qui peut déjà m'appuyer moi ici afin qu'on puisse aller de l'avant avec tous ces documents l'élaboration des documents de l'analyse

statement: A partner reporting platform has been running since 2023 with 86 active partners reporting directly, and it carries the sector's activity reporting, budgeting, partner capacity, stock data and a service-mapping dashboard rather than activity data alone.
quote: we have almost now active 86 partners reporting directly to activity info we activated activity info since 2023 activity info actually the only platform used for everything for our sector not only the five Ws

statement: Moving partner reporting off spreadsheets onto a shared platform produced a marked improvement in the quality of reporting and gave the coordination team control over data and reporting frequency that spreadsheets had not allowed.
quote: quality of report really different a lot from using activity info than the Excel you know and you can you have full control on the data and how the frequency everything

statement: Partners running small-budget interventions report reach figures far beyond what the budget could plausibly deliver, and the coordination team caps the reported total in response — so the published reach understates the response rather than overstating it.
quote: some partner doing a very limited budget intervention and they said that we are reaching 1 million people which is not true which will make inflation in the reach and that pushed me to do some capping on the reach

statement: Beneficiary counting breaks differently for the two kinds of WASH intervention: large-scale rehabilitation serving a catchment, and item distribution reaching identifiable individuals, cannot be counted on the same basis.
quote: in Wash we have two kinds of intervention these larger scale interventions like rehabilitation and we have distribution so we have an issue of estimation or the beneficiary counting

statement: One approach to constraining implausible reach claims is to derive a ceiling from the budget: a stated intervention cost implies a maximum plausible share of the catchment population, tested in two other responses.
quote: examples that I know of from Venezuela and Ukraine where we tried to define it based on a financial amount so if it's 5000 bucks you can only possibly reach to a certain percentage of the catchment population

statement: The same reach-counting problem is reported from another country in the region, where partners have been observed counting an entire community as reached.
quote: as I know also Yemen team they are suffering with reach calculation they told me sometimes the partners they count the whole community

statement: Pressure to reconcile reported reach with available budget is pushing the reporting debate toward a binary of direct and indirect beneficiaries, which fits poorly where the right intervention is to repair a shared water system.
quote: they're trying to make sure that we don't overreach with not enough budget in a context where the right intervention is to repair a water system at that point that's a direct intervention

statement: The line ministry is described as actively interested in the sector coordination system and pushing for it, rather than merely tolerating it — an unusual starting position for a handover.
quote: this government is very interested in the sector system indeed people and they are really aware of the importance of the sector they are supporting it pushing on that
